verdict.rationale: Publishing current processing times is a fair question for a government tax agency, so the axis applies. The evidence pack holds only two probes, both recording Akamai 403 walls at www.ftb.ca.gov and webapp.ftb.ca.gov. No content was fetched, so nothing shows FTB publishing processing times for any transaction type.

support.subject: As a founder, current processing times for my transaction type are published by the service itself
